hero.name: Adam Airil
hero.subtitle: Bridging Data Analytics with Artificial Intelligence to build scalable, and data-driven solutions.

about.passion: I am an AI and Data Professional focused on bridging deep data analytics with machine learning pipelines. I transform messy organizational and operational datasets into clean architectural insights, prioritizing security, structural integrity, and computational efficiency.
about.education: Master by Research in Information and Communication Technology student at Universiti Teknikal Malaysia Melaka (UTeM), continuing from my BSc. in Artificial Intelligence with a CGPA of 3.96. Recipient of the Vice Chancellor’s Award, a straight Dean's List achiever (Semesters 1-6), and Gold Award winner at the Workshop 2 Innovation Competition.
about.activities: Active technical contributor and leader within the UTeM ecosystem. Served as a planning committee member for the Code Challenge Arena, competitor in Hackathon FTMK, and an active team comrade for Faculty Ultras. Experienced public speaker, representing my cohort as the Dean's List student speaker and working as an emcee for formal faculty programs and the campus Neon Run.

timeline.description: Engineered a secure Data Privacy Assessment Web Application Prototype using PHP, SQL, and AJAX to evaluate sensitive data risks across complex organizational profiles. Authored comprehensive User Requirement Specifications (URS) and Concept Design (CD) technical system documentation.
